entries.01538373b2603f07: This business manufactures and sells film products. Oji F-Tex Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells specialty paper, films and other items. Thermal film is manufactured and sold by Oji Imaging Media Co., Ltd., and adhesive film is manufactured and sold by Oji Takku Co., Ltd. and Shin Takku Kasei Co., Ltd.
entries.0a203c6bbc782d9c: This business procures and manufactures pulp, the raw material for paper, for sale. Oji Green Resources Co., Ltd. carries out procurement and sales of raw and fuel materials used within the group, pulp and other items. Celulose Nipo-Brasileira S.A., Oji Fibre Solutions (NZ) Ltd. and Pan Pac Forest Products Ltd. manufacture and sell pulp, and Jiangsu Oji Paper Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells pulp mainly for the Chinese market. Nihaku Kami Parupu Shigen Kaihatsu Co., Ltd. is a holding company that holds all shares of Celulose Nipo-Brasileira S.A. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, pulp market conditions deteriorated overseas.
entries.137eede8dc3da88d: This business is listed in the main business descriptions of the reportable segment as one of the Living Industry Materials. The business description does not describe the individual companies or products that carry out this business.
entries.18681a0272be9834: This business generates electricity from biomass such as wood and sells it. MPM Oji Eco Energy Co., Ltd. (ownership ratio of voting rights: 55.0%) and Oji Green Energy Tokushima Co., Ltd. (80.0%) operate biomass power generation businesses. As of March 31, 2026, Oji Green Energy Tokushima Co., Ltd.'s principal facilities include biomass power generation equipment, including the Tomioka Eco Energy Power Station (Anan, Tokushima Prefecture) and others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, electricity sales increased in the domestic energy business.
entries.1e8b2ebf53a88932: This business plants and grows trees, procures and produces logs, chips and pulp for sale, and also generates electricity through biomass power generation. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥346,317 million, up 0.3% from the previous year. In Japan, revenue exceeded the previous year as electricity sales in the energy business increased. Overseas, Pan Pac Forest Products Ltd. of New Zealand increased sales as it recovered from damage caused by a cyclone, but overseas revenue fell below the previous year due to deteriorating pulp market conditions and other factors. Oji Cornstarch Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells saccharified products and other items in this category.
entries.2ac58e2bff769a61: This business produces white paperboard and paper containers (boxes and containers made of paper) for sale. Oji Materia Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells white paperboard and other items, and Oji Packaging Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells paper containers.
entries.2c9547dd093ede3a: This business manufactures and sells adhesive paper and adhesive films used for labels. In Japan, Oji Takku Co., Ltd. and Shin Takku Kasei Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell adhesive paper, adhesive films and other items. Adampak Pte. Ltd. and Oji Paper (Thailand) Ltd. manufacture and sell adhesive paper, adhesive films and other items mainly for Southeast Asian markets. In September 2022, the company acquired shares of Adampak Pte. Ltd., the parent company of the Adampak Group, which has business bases in 6 countries in Southeast Asia and China.
entries.2e0cfdd87e338edd: This business manufactures and sells paper used for printed matter, publications and information purposes. Oji Paper Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells printing, publishing and information paper and other items, and Jiangsu Oji Paper Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells printing and publishing paper and other items mainly for the Chinese market.
entries.504ccd3acbc93c21: White Paperboard and Paper Container Business
entries.51691bf2790c3756: This business manufactures and sells paper for newspapers and paper for printing, publishing and information use. Oji Paper Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells these products, and Jiangsu Oji Paper Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells printing and publishing paper and other items mainly for the Chinese market. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥213,194 million, down 6.9% from the previous year. In Japan, prices were revised, but because demand for newsprint and printing and information paper continued to decline, revenue fell below the previous year. Overseas, revenue fell below the previous year because Jiangsu Oji Paper experienced price declines accompanying deteriorating market conditions.
entries.5b6afbe2365639b1: Packaging Paper and Bag Making Business
entries.5b9bbf5cf689cc9a: This business manufactures and sells paper and films with functions suited to their uses, such as specialty paper, thermal paper, adhesive paper and films. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥220,941 million, down 0.2% from the previous year. In Japan, revenue increased in the specialty paper business owing to expanded sales and price revisions of heat-seal paper and non-fluorine oil-resistant paper, which are strategic products for mail-order use, but revenue fell below the previous year due to the impact of the sale of Chuetsu in August 2024 and a partial decline in demand for thermal film. Overseas, revenue increased in the thermal business owing to the effect of currency translation. Oji Kinocloth Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells nonwoven fabrics and other items, and Oji Kino Paper (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. of China manufactures and sells nonwoven fabrics and other items mainly for the Chinese market. At its Nakatsu Mill, Oji F-Tex Co., Ltd. will carry out expansion work to raise production capacity to about 3 times the current level, in response to growing demand for cellulose-based pressboard for transformers.
entries.6596fc25bd469e53: This business produces packaging paper and paper bags for sale. In Japan, Oji Materia Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells packaging paper and other items, and Oji Seitai Co., Ltd., Chuetsu Package Co., Ltd. and Oji Adva Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell paper bag products and other items. In China, Suzhou Oji Packaging Co., Ltd. and Oji Packaging (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell packaging paper and paper bag products and other items, mainly for the Chinese market.
entries.68f2af7def729850: This category covers business segments not included in the reportable segments, including trading, logistics, engineering, real estate and corporate-related operations. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥207,137 million, up 0.2% from the previous year. Kyokuyo Co., Ltd. sells raw materials and products such as paper, pulp and synthetic resins; Oji Logistics Co., Ltd. provides transportation and warehousing; Oji Engineering Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures plants and machinery and carries out engineering business; Oji Real Estate Co., Ltd. carries out civil engineering and construction work and real estate sales, brokerage, leasing and management; Ginpo Pack Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells plastic containers; and Hotel New Oji Co., Ltd. operates a hotel business in Tomakomai City, Hokkaido. Oji Management Office Co., Ltd., a subsidiary performing holding company functions, handles group head office functions such as personnel, accounting, planning and finance, and Oji Asia Management Sdn. Bhd. is the regional headquarters company for Southeast Asia, covering areas other than the industrial materials business. AustroCel Hallein GmbH operates a biorefinery business that produces dissolving pulp, biofuel (next-generation bioethanol) and other products from wood raw materials, and the acquisition of its shares was completed in January 2026. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, the method changed: group head office costs, which had previously been allocated to each reportable segment, are no longer allocated to the segments and are instead included in this category for presentation. In March 2026, Oji Real Estate sold rental real estate that it owned.
entries.6ff28f867cbea25e: This business produces and sells paper containers for liquids such as beverages. IPI S.r.l. of Italy manufactures and sells liquid paper containers and other items. As growth investment, the company decided to build a new liquid paper container plant in Vietnam and established a new company for the construction. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, this business has been classified under Living Industry Materials instead of 'Other'.
entries.7076d8dba4f95708: This business produces and sells packaging materials with enhanced environmental considerations. Walki Oy of Finland manufactures and sells sustainable packaging and other items. In April 2024, the company acquired shares of Walki Holding Oy, the holding company of the Walki Group, a European manufacturer of sustainable packaging materials. As of March 31, 2026, Walki Holding Oy's principal facilities include sustainable packaging material production equipment at its Valkeakoski Mill (Valkeakoski, Finland) and 14 other plants. Sustainable packaging is listed as one of the strategic businesses in which growth investment is concentrated. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, this business has been classified under Living Industry Materials instead of 'Other'.
entries.73b1e9e718525281: Corrugated Base Paper and Corrugated Processing Business
entries.7a3cf6638866da06: Printing, Publishing and Information Paper Business
entries.87bf123e8fdb9499: Tree Planting and Wood Processing Business
entries.9fb1acb370dd78e0: This business manufactures and sells paper for newspapers. Oji Paper Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells newsprint and other items. Oji Paper suspended one newsprint production machine in March 2026.
entries.a7bf27fe9fd57a7b: This business grows forests and procures and processes logs and chips for sale. In Japan, Oji Mokuzai Ryokka Co., Ltd. carries out tree planting and forest management, as well as procurement, processing and sale of logs, chips and other items. Overseas, Celulose Nipo-Brasileira S.A. holds plantation land in Brazil, and Oji Fibre Solutions (NZ) Ltd. and Pan Pac Forest Products Ltd. hold plantation land in New Zealand, and these companies procure, process and sell logs and chips. PT. Korintiga Hutani holds plantation land in Indonesia, Oji Uruguay Forest Company S.A.S. in Uruguay, and Mogno das Alterosas Investimentos Florestais S.A. in Brazil.
entries.aa2a8b81ac16557a: This business sells specialty paper made to suit specific uses. Oji F-Tex Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells specialty paper, films and other items. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, domestic specialty paper revenue increased owing to expanded sales and price revisions of heat-seal paper and non-fluorine oil-resistant paper for mail-order use, which are strategic products.
entries.ad4c0814ea90854b: A corporate group with forests at its core, handling paper, corrugated cardboard, household paper, functional paper and film, pulp, and electricity from biomass power generation.
entries.bae42a281c84e421: This is the group's largest segment, selling packaging materials such as corrugated boxes, paperboard boxes and paper bags, as well as household paper and disposable diapers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥874,117 million, up 3.2% year on year (prior-year figures are restated to the revised segment classification). In Japan, price revisions had an effect on corrugated boxes, adult diapers and household paper, but reduced consumption due to rising prices lowered sales volumes, and the withdrawal of children's diapers from the domestic business in September 2024 also contributed, so revenue fell below the previous year. Overseas, revenue exceeded the previous year because the company acquired Walki and made it a consolidated subsidiary in its sustainable packaging business. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, the sustainable packaging business and the liquid paper container business, previously classified under "Others," have been moved into this segment.
entries.bd6e3e65db8a9fbf: This business manufactures and sells thermal paper, thermal film and other products that develop color when heated. In Japan, Oji Imaging Media Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells thermal paper, thermal film, information paper and other items. Overseas, Oji Papéis Especiais Ltda. manufactures and sells thermal paper and other items mainly for the Central and South American market, Kanzaki Specialty Papers Inc. mainly for the North American market, KANZAN Spezialpapiere GmbH mainly for the European market, and Oji Paper (Thailand) Ltd. and Tele-Paper (M) Sdn. Bhd. mainly for the Southeast Asian market. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the overseas thermal business's revenue increased owing to the effect of currency translation, while demand for some domestic thermal film decreased.
entries.c23ff2ce636f20c6: This business produces corrugated base paper and processes that base paper into corrugated products for sale. In Japan, Oji Materia Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells corrugated base paper, and Oji Container Co., Ltd., Mori Shigyo Co., Ltd. and Oji Interpack Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell corrugated products and other items. Overseas, GS Paperboard & Packaging Sdn. Bhd., Harta Packaging Industries Sdn. Bhd., Ojitex (Vietnam) Co., Ltd., Ojitex Haiphong Co., Ltd. and S.Pack & Print Public Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell corrugated products and other items mainly for Southeast Asian markets, Oji India Packaging Pvt. Ltd. mainly for the Indian market, and Oji Fibre Solutions (NZ) Ltd. mainly for the Oceania market. As of March 31, 2026, Oji Container Co., Ltd.'s principal facilities include corrugated product production equipment at its Tochigi Mill (Utsunomiya, Tochigi Prefecture) and 25 other plants. Oji Fibre Solutions of New Zealand withdrew from the corrugated base paper business in June 2025, sold its Australian packaging business in November of that year and its waste paper business in December, and decided to close its paperboard processing plant in June 2026.
entries.cda312964f21fd66: This business produces and sells household paper and paper diapers. Oji Nepia Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells household paper and paper diapers, Oji Asia Household Product Sdn. Bhd. manufactures and sells paper diapers mainly for Southeast Asian markets, and Jiangsu Oji Paper Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells household paper mainly for the Chinese market. Oji Nepia reviewed its production structure: it closed its Edogawa Mill in August 2025, and it suspended and closed its Tomakomai Mill in March 2026. The company withdrew from the domestic children's diaper business in September 2024.
